newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduran widow holds husband's wake in city square.
newsitem.headline: Honduran widow holds husband's wake in city square.

text.p: A homeless Honduran widow held her late husband's wake in the capital city's main plaza early on Wednesday.

Virginia Rivera, 61, said she put her husband's corpse on display in front of Honduras' Metropolitan Cathedral because she had no place to take the body and could not afford to rent a funeral parlour.
"I have no other place to hold a wake," Rivera told curious onlookers in the square.
Some put flowers on the makeshift wooden coffin. Some gave Rivera money to help her bury her husband.
